english.quote: We require at least a 7.5 overall band score on either the paper-based or computer-delivered Academic Examination and give consideration to those with subscores of 7.5 and above. When sending your official IELTS scores, please ensure that you choose "Carnegie Mellon University – Office of Undergraduate Admission" as the recipient for your score report. TOEFL iBT or iBT Home Edition For exams taken before Jan. 21, 2026: We require at least a 102 overall score
english.notes: Required of nonnative English speakers. IELTS Academic 7.5 overall (subscores of 7.5 'given consideration', not a stated minimum). TOEFL iBT (exams before 21 January 2026) 102 overall; on or after 21 January 2026: 5 overall. TOEFL Essentials 11. DET 135 overall and Cambridge 191 are further down the same page (beyond the converter's 600-character excerpt, so not in this quote). Scores no more than two years old at application.
